lead: Short worksheets that turn real space missions into school science problems. Teachers can print one for each student, and students can practise on screen.
try: Under Topic, pick a button such as India in space. When you have tried the questions, press Show answers (teacher) to see the worked answers.
points: Every question names a lab where you can check your answer by changing the numbers yourself.
There are six topics, from gravity and orbits to light and telescopes and India's own space missions.
One question shows why the space station is easiest to see just after sunset: our sky is already dark, but the station, high above, is still in sunlight.
